sections.heading: WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO PLAY
sections.middleText1: two single or multi-message switches record: "next" on one switch "add to album" on the other
sections.middleText2: A phone or tablet with photos from an event or activity the switch user took part in

sections.heading: HOW TO PLAY
sections.body:
1. Invite the switch user to create a photo album about the event or activity.
2. Show one photo at a time.
3. If the switch user presses "Next", show the next photo.
4. If they press "Add to album", add the photo to the album.
5. Look through the finished album together and share it with others if you wish.
